question: Do bright-peak and dim-extreme sharp anchors have qualitatively different survivor cluster topology on SO(3)?
hypothesis: Bright anchors spread along a direction (multi-specular) while dim anchors collapse into a few discrete clusters.
narrative_md: Greedy clustering of survivor sets at sharp anchors on SO(3) (20 deg / 40 deg thresholds) confirms the user's intuition: bright-peak anchors fragment into 7-8 small clusters separated by ~170 deg (body-twin specular) with no consolidation, while dim-extreme anchors collapse into 4-5 clean clusters carrying 88-92% of survivors in the top-3. Dim anchors play the discrete-enumerator role; bright anchors play the passage-validator role. Foundation for the s060 multi-anchor design.
